templates.name: Souq
templates.description: Warm café site with a big hero, signature picks and a searchable menu with photos.

defaults.hero.title: Coffee worth crossing the city for.
defaults.hero.subtitle: Specialty coffee roasted in-house, fresh bakes every morning and a quiet corner to stay a while.
defaults.announcement: Now open until midnight on Thursdays and Fridays
defaults.highlights.1.title: Roasted in-house
defaults.highlights.1.text: Small batches every week, single origin and house blend.
defaults.highlights.2.title: Baked before sunrise
defaults.highlights.2.text: Croissants, cookies and cakes made from scratch daily.
defaults.highlights.3.title: Open late
defaults.highlights.3.text: Stay for one more cup. See our hours below.
defaults.story.title: A small counter that grew into a neighborhood spot
defaults.story.text: We started with one machine and a small counter. Today we roast our own beans every week, bake from scratch before sunrise, and still know most of our regulars by name.

templates.name: Linen List
templates.description: A printed menu on linen paper: text only, dotted lines to the prices, one or two columns.

defaults.note: Prices include tax. Tell us about any allergies.
defaults.hero.title: Home cooking, the way our grandmothers made it.
defaults.hero.subtitle: Mezze to share, bread from the oven and slow-cooked dishes from family recipes. Come hungry.
defaults.story.title: Our kitchen
defaults.story.text: Every recipe on this menu came from a family kitchen. We cook the same way: fresh every morning, slowly, and with more olive oil than you would expect.

templates.name: Night Market
templates.description: Dark and loud: big photo cards you swipe through, one row per category.

defaults.hero.title: Smashed. Stacked. Served hot.
defaults.hero.subtitle: Burgers, pizza and loaded fries until late. Order ahead on WhatsApp and skip the line.
defaults.announcement: Free fries with every double on Tuesdays

templates.name: Arch Story
templates.description: A magazine for sweet shops: arched photos, menu chapters and cards you swipe.

defaults.hero.title: Small sweet things, made slowly.
defaults.hero.subtitle: Ice cream churned in the shop, doughnuts from brioche dough and cakes for every kind of day.
defaults.story.title: Every flavor starts in our kitchen
defaults.story.text: We make our ice cream in small batches with fresh milk and real fruit, and we bake the doughnuts the same morning you eat them. Nothing sits on the shelf overnight.

templates.name: Pocket Catalog
templates.description: A shop catalog: filter by category, sort by price and ask about any item on WhatsApp.

defaults.hero.title: Things for slow mornings at home
defaults.hero.subtitle: Handmade candles, mugs, soaps and plants from small makers in Amman. Ask about any item on WhatsApp.
defaults.ask: Hello! I would like to order:
defaults.announcement: Free delivery in Amman over 25 JD
defaults.story.title: Made by people we know
defaults.story.text: Every product in our shop comes from a maker we have met in person. We keep the list small and change it with the seasons.

templates.name: Chalk Board
templates.description: A café blackboard: hand lettering, a daily special and boxed menu sections.

defaults.hero.title: Coffee, cake and good chats
defaults.special.title: Today's special
defaults.special.note: Ask us about it, we love this one
defaults.story.title: Hello!
defaults.story.text: We are a small coffee bar with a big chalkboard. The menu changes with the seasons, so come back often.

templates.name: Bento
templates.description: A bento box of tiles in mixed sizes; featured drinks get the big tiles.

defaults.hero.title: Pressed this morning, poured for you
defaults.hero.subtitle: Fresh juices, smoothies and mocktails made to order. No syrups, no shortcuts.
defaults.announcement: Build your own juice: pick any three fruits
defaults.story.title: Fruit first
defaults.story.text: We buy fruit from the central market every morning and press it when you order. What we do not sell by evening goes to the compost, never to tomorrow.

templates.name: Neon Diner
templates.description: A retro diner: neon sign, checkered strips and numbered combo cards.

defaults.hero.title: Smashed burgers, hot fries, cold shakes
defaults.announcement: Combo Tuesday: any burger with fries and a drink
defaults.story.title: Since the first smash
defaults.story.text: Two friends, one hot griddle and a recipe for house sauce we still will not share. Everything is cooked to order, so give us a few minutes.

templates.name: Zen
templates.description: A quiet, minimal menu with big numerals, hairlines and small square photos.

defaults.hero.title: Simple food, made with care
defaults.hero.subtitle: Sushi pressed by hand, ramen broth cooked for twelve hours, and a short menu that changes with the season.
defaults.announcement: Lunch set every weekday from 12 to 3
defaults.story.title: Our way
defaults.story.text: We make a few things and we make them slowly. The rice is seasoned by hand, the broth starts the night before, and every bowl leaves the kitchen when it is ready, not before.

templates.name: Bistro Card
templates.description: A folded menu card on a tablecloth: cover with today's dish, courses inside.

defaults.hero.title: Home cooking, the way our grandmother made it
defaults.special.title: Today's dish
defaults.story.title: The house
defaults.story.text: Bait Sitti means grandmother's house. The recipes are hers, the plates are big and there is always room for one more at the table.

templates.name: Pizzeria
templates.description: A wood-fired pizza place: round photo cutouts on colored bands, one per category.

defaults.hero.title: Wood fired, ninety seconds, done
defaults.hero.subtitle: Dough rested for 48 hours, tomatoes from Italy and za'atar from our hills.
defaults.announcement: Two pizzas and a salad for 15 JD, every Monday
defaults.story.title: From our oven
defaults.story.text: Our oven was built by hand and burns oak at 450 degrees. A pizza takes ninety seconds, which is just enough time to choose the next one.

templates.name: Ticket
templates.description: A menu printed as a till receipt: monospace lines, zigzag edges and a barcode.

defaults.hero.title: Coffee on wheels
defaults.location: Today: Rainbow Street, next to the old cinema
defaults.announcement: Bring your own cup, get 0.25 off

templates.name: Garden
templates.description: Organic shapes, leaves and cards that put diet tags first.

defaults.hero.title: Slow mornings, good food
defaults.hero.subtitle: All-day brunch, big bowls and fresh juice. Most of the menu is vegetarian and every dish is marked.
defaults.announcement: Weekend brunch from 9, no booking needed
defaults.story.title: Grown with love
defaults.story.text: Our vegetables come from two family farms in the Jordan Valley. We cook what is in season and bake our bread every morning.

templates.name: Mono Grid
templates.description: A Swiss-style catalog: hairline grid, index numbers and one signal color.

defaults.hero.title: Objects for everyday use. Made in small batches, sold in one room.
defaults.story.title: About
defaults.story.text: A small concept store for useful things. We work with local makers and keep every object in stock for as long as they make it.

templates.name: Spice Route
templates.description: Geometric star borders, an arched window and centered courses. Looks its best in Arabic.

defaults.hero.title: Recipes from Levantine kitchens, shared at a big table
defaults.announcement: Family platters for four every Friday
defaults.story.title: Our story
defaults.story.text: Three generations of cooks, one long table. We grind our own spices, bake bread in a stone oven and serve every mezze to share.

templates.name: Polaroid
templates.description: A wall of instant photos, slightly tilted, taped up and captioned by hand.

defaults.hero.title: Ice cream, doughnuts and cake, made today
defaults.announcement: Free sprinkles on every scoop this week
defaults.story.title: Hello from us
defaults.story.text: We are a tiny sweet shop with a big freezer. Everything is made in our kitchen in the morning and sold until it runs out.
